title: Stonier Pies & Pinot (King's Birthday Weekend)
summary: Annual Stonier King's Birthday weekend: Pinot duck pies, Chardonnay chicken pies and Chardonnay mushroom & tarragon pies (Millers Bread Kitchen / Peninsula Backhouse), poured with the new-release 2025 Pinot Noir. No bookings, fire's on.
freePaid: Free (cellar door; pies purchased on site)
priceRange: Pies approx AUD 12–18; wines by glass/bottle
accessibilityNotes: Flat lawn area; cellar door wheelchair accessible, check with venue
nearbyAttractions: Winter Wine Festival at Red Hill Showgrounds; Paringa Estate Restaurant; Foxeys Hangout
suggestedItineraryPairing: Start with Winter Wine Festival on Saturday; return Sunday for Pies & Pinot with vineyard tour
editorVerdict: A glass of the new-release 2025 Pinot, a duck pie, the fire going. There is no better King's Birthday move on the Peninsula.
editorNote:
Stonier's Pies & Pinot is the annual King's Birthday weekend the locals quietly book the rest of the year around. No bookings, no fuss, just the new-release 2025 Pinot Noir alongside three pies from Millers Bread Kitchen: Pinot duck, Chardonnay chicken, Chardonnay mushroom and tarragon.

The right play is Sunday lunchtime: arrive at 11:30, grab a pie and a glass, find a spot near the fire or out on the lawn. Walk it off with a lap of the vineyard. The Saturday Winter Wine Festival at Red Hill Showgrounds is the natural Saturday-then-Stonier pairing.

Dogs welcome, kids fine on the lawn, no need to over-plan. One of the easiest, most genuine cellar door days of the year.
